column1: # import-audit assert cases: frozen expectations (rev 1), derived from the SPEC / RESEARCH.md B5, never from a run.
# Columns (TAB separated): case, stdout_mode, expected_exit, expected_verdict, required_record_regex, premise
# required_record_regex: ERE matched against the tool output lines (CR stripped); several regexes are joined by ;; and ALL must match; - = none.
# premise: pass = positive premise must exit 0; fail-on-broken = positive exits 0 AND <case>.broken premise exits 1; n/a = none.
# Records are printed by the tool indented two spaces, e.g. "  G changed parseInt x1".

column5: ^  G proto Promise\.then \[changed\] x1$;;^  P PromiseThenLookupChain x1$
^  G proto Array\.0 \[added\] x1$;;^  P NoElements x1$
^  G proto Array\.Symbol\(Symbol\.isConcatSpreadable\) \[added\] x1$;;^  P IsConcatSpreadableLookupChain x1$
